items.source: In case of a conversion hint being provided, the framework will call the extended method if a converter implements this interface, instead of calling the regular toMessage variant.
items.translation: 如果提供了转换提示，当转换器实现该接口时，框架将调用扩展方法，而不是调用常规的 `toMessage` 变体。

items.source: A variant of MessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session) which takes an extra conversion context as an argument, allowing to take, for example, annotations on a payload parameter into account.
items.translation: 这是 `MessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session)` 的一个变体，它接受一个额外的转换上下文作为参数，从而可以例如考虑负载参数的注解。

items.source: conversionHint - an extra object passed to the MessageConverter, for example, the associated MethodParameter (may be null)
items.translation: conversionHint - 传递给MessageConverter的额外对象，例如关联的MethodParameter（可能为null）

items.source: MessageConversionException - in case of conversion failure
items.translation: MessageConversionException - 在转换失败的情况下

items.source: session - the Session to use for creating a JMS Message
items.translation: session - 用于创建 JMS 消息的会话

items.source: jakarta.jms.JMSException - if thrown by JMS API methods
items.translation: jakarta.jms.JMSException - 如果由 JMS API 方法抛出
